install.notes: The root setup.py installs parkour_isaaclab; the task package parkour_tasks is a second package and its README installs it separately (README.md:21-25). The task extension declares isaaclab and isaaclab_assets as external dependencies (parkour_tasks/config/extension.toml:15-16) and the task needs Isaac Sim and a GPU. The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not run and needs an installed Isaac Lab, the task package imported so the gym id is registered, and a GPU.
